title: What If One Cashier Served All of McDonald's?
description:
What if one cashier had to serve every McDonald's customer in a single day?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: McDonald's (68 million customers daily; 45,356 restaurants at end of 2025): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McDonald%27s

Per-second = 68 million / 86,400 seconds; per-minute = 787 x 60; per-hour = 68 million / 24; ~95% franchised (same source); per-restaurant = 68 million / 45,356. Not financial advice.

#shorts #mcdonalds #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you're in a McDonald's line, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: What if one cashier had to serve every McDonald's customer in a single day?
After one second, that's 787 customers. B: Wait, every second? Yep. No breaks.
After one minute, about 47,000 people. The line wraps around the block.
After one hour, 2.8 million. By the end of the day? 68 million customers.
So McDonald's spreads them across 45,356 restaurants. That's about 1,500 each.
The twist? About 95 percent are run by franchisees. McDonald's is mostly the landlord.

sources.title: Wikipedia: McDonald's (68 million customers daily; 45,356 restaurants at end of 2025)
